text: This is Full-time MBA program, you should complete your study in two years (consisting of four consecutive semesters); SISU MBA Program is split into two different yet complementary learning experiences. The required courses cover traditional management disciplines, leadership, ethics, and interpersonal skills needed in business world, as well as integration and global experience module. The elective courses develop your career goals from the different areas. Required Course The Pre-Term program ensures that the new class begins the fall term with a consistent level of introductory knowledge. You are required to participate in all the activities in the Pre-Term as it is part of the required courses of SISU MBA. The Pre-Term program offers: preparatory courses in accounting, finance and statistics in fundamental level to make sure you understand the basic knowledge prior to fall term coursework. language courses, seminars in career development, as well as lectures in soft skills workshops. Varied sharing sessions from faculty and employers are a prominent part of Pre-Term to prepare you for MBA study planning and know about the perspectives from outside community. induction session to university’s facilities and resources, rules and regulations to guide your MBA journey. case day to familiarize you with this typical MBA learning method. one-day off-campus team-building to build up team spirit. You will be assigned to a learning team for the first semester of the program.
